title: Horizontal slices x ↦ ψ(cons(s,x))∘ι of a test form and of its e₀-derivative are test forms (supplied step 2)
statement: Let m, q ∈ ℕ and ψ ∈ D^q(ℝ^{m+1}) = TestFormOn univ q. Then there are families Ψ, Ψ′ : ℝ → D^q(ℝ^m) such that for all s ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^m and v : Fin q → ℝ^m: Ψ(s)(x)(v) = ψ(cons(s,x))(fun i => ι(v i)) and Ψ′(s)(x)(v) = (fderiv ℝ ψ (cons(s,x)) e₀)(fun i => ι(v i)), where cons(s,x) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)), ι(w) := cons(0, w) and e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (m q : ℕ) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) q), ∃ Ψ Ψ' : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) q, (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))) ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Eucl m) (v : Fin q → Eucl m), (Ψ' s : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) q) x v = fderiv ℝ (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) q) ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons 0 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ (v i))))
